description: 2020 NCFO Operators File is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by USDOT/OST-R/BTS/ODDS. This is the Operators file for the 2020 National Census of Ferry Operators. It is one of five data sets that make up the 2020 NCFO. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 51 columns, among them PUB_FUND_TYPE_3, PUB_FUND_TYPE_1, PUB_FUND_SOURCE_8, PUB_FUND_SOURCE_6, PUB_FUND_PROG_7, PUB_FUND_PROG_6. The portal shows 2022-04-22 as the last data update. Attribution given: USDOT/OST-R/BTS/ODDS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
